title: Breakfast in November
setting: A cozy cafe on a cold November morning.

characters.name: Sara
characters.look: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt)

characters.name: Hana
characters.look: Hana (a woman of about thirty with a black bob and fringe, red glasses and a grey blazer)

sentences.en: In November, Sara and Hana meet at a cafe.
sentences.zh: 十一月，萨拉和哈娜在一家咖啡馆见面。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt) and Hana (a woman of about thirty with a black bob and fringe, red glasses and a grey blazer) meet at the door of a cozy cafe on a cold grey day, bare trees and fallen leaves outside.
sentences.draw_note: Shows the two friends meeting at a cafe on a cold day; the month can't be shown.

sentences.en: Sara wears a yellow dress and a warm jacket.
sentences.zh: 萨拉穿着一条黄色连衣裙和一件暖和的外套。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt), now wearing a yellow dress and a warm brown jacket instead of her shirt and skirt, stands inside the cafe.

sentences.en: They have a quick breakfast at a small table.
sentences.zh: 她们在一张小桌旁匆匆吃了早餐。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt) and Hana (a woman of about thirty with a black bob and fringe, red glasses and a grey blazer) eat a quick breakfast of bread and coffee at a small cafe table.

sentences.en: Hana asks Sara about her trip in August.
sentences.zh: 哈娜问萨拉八月的旅行怎么样。
sentences.scene_prompt: Hana (a woman of about thirty with a black bob and fringe, red glasses and a grey blazer) leans forward with a curious face and asks Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt) a question across the table.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Hana asking Sara something; the trip and the month can't be shown.

sentences.en: Her grandma lives in a place by the sea.
sentences.zh: 她的奶奶住在海边的一个地方。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt) shows Hana (a woman of about thirty with a black bob and fringe, red glasses and a grey blazer) a photo on her phone: an old woman waving at the door of a small house by the sea.
sentences.draw_note: Shows a photo of an old woman's house by the sea; 'her grandma' and 'lives' are only hinted.

sentences.en: Sara puts four beach photos on the table.
sentences.zh: 萨拉把四张海滩照片放在桌上。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt) lays four printed photos of a sunny beach on the cafe table while Hana (a woman of about thirty with a black bob and fringe, red glasses and a grey blazer) looks at them.

sentences.en: Then Sara takes her bag to catch a bus.
sentences.zh: 然后萨拉拿起包去赶公交车。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt) picks up her bag and hurries out of the cafe toward a waiting bus, Hana (a woman of about thirty with a black bob and fringe, red glasses and a grey blazer) waving.
